description: Department of Local Government - North Western Province - The Meeting for the purpose of electing the Deputy Chairman for the Rideegama Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice announces the schedule for an election meeting to elect the Deputy Chairman for the Rideegama Pradeshiya Sabha. It is published under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and specifically relates to electoral processes at the local government level, making it a clear fit for Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
